रक्षणीरक: रक्षणीरक m. (-कः) Urinary affection, as gonorrhœa, &c.; elsewhere read रक्षणारक ।
रक्षत्: रक्षत् mfn. (-क्षन्-क्षन्ती-क्षत्) Preserving, guarding, protecting.  E. रक्ष् to preserve, शतृ aff.
रक्षस्: रक्षस् n. (-क्षः) Rākshas, an evil spirit, apparently distinguishable into three classes; one sort of Rākshas is of a domi-celestial nature and is ranked with the attendants on KUVERA; another corres-ponds to a goblin, an imp, or ogre, haunting cemeteries, animat-ing dead bodies, disturbing sacrifices, and ensnaring and devour-ing human beings; the third kind approaches more to the nature of the Titan, or relentless, and powerful enemy of the gods.  E. रक्ष् to preserve, (KUVERA'S treasure, &c.) असुन् aff.; also राक्षस ।
रक्षस्पाश: रक्षस्पाश m. (-शः) A contemptible Rākshas.  E. रक्षस्, and पाश aff.
रक्षाधिकृत: रक्षाधिकृत m. (-तः) A governor, a magistrate.  E. रक्षा, अघिकृत set over.
रक्षापत्र: रक्षापत्र m. (-त्रः) A sort of birch-tree. “श्वेतसर्षपे च ।”
रक्षापेक्षक: रक्षापेक्षक m. (-कः) 	 1. A door-keeper or porter. 	 2. A guard of the women's apartments. 	 3. A catamite. 	 4. An actor, a mine.  E. रक्ष् preserving, अप् before, ईक्ष् to see, aff. वुन् ।
रक्षाप्रदीप: रक्षाप्रदीप m. (-पः) A light kept burning for protection against the evil spirits.
रक्षामणि: रक्षामणि m. (-णिः) An ornament or jewel worn as a preservative.
रक्षित: रक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Preserved, protected, defended. 	 2. Kept, detained.  E. रक्ष् to preserve, aff. क्त ।
रक्षितव्य: रक्षितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be guarded, protected, &c.  E. रक्ष् to preserve, तव्य aff.
रक्षितृ: रक्षितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Who or what protects, defends, &c., a protector, a guard.  E. रक्ष् to preserve, तृच् aff.
रक्षिन्: रक्षिन् mfn. (-क्षी-क्षिणी-क्षि) Who or what preserves, &c.  E. रक्ष् to pre-serve, घिनुण् aff.
रक्षिवर्ग: रक्षिवर्ग m. (-र्गः) A guard, a sentinel.  E. रक्षि from रक्षिन् a preserver, वर्ग class.
रक्षोगण: रक्षोगण m. (-णः) A class or troop of evil spirits.  E. रक्षस्, गण a troop.
रक्षोघ्न: रक्षोघ्न m. (-घ्नः) Marking-nut plant. 	 n. (-घ्न) 	 1. Sour gruel made from the fermentation of rice-water. 	 2. Asafœtida.  E. रक्षस् a goblin, and घ्न destroying, repelling.
रक्षोजननी: रक्षोजननी f. (-नी) Night.  E. रक्षस् a spirit, जननी mother.
रक्ष्ण: रक्ष्ण m. (-क्ष्णः) Preserving, guarding, protection.  E. रक्ष् to preserve, aff. नङ् ।
रक्ष्य: रक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) To be guarded, protected, &c.  E. रक्ष् to preserve, यत् aff.
रक्ष्यमाण: रक्ष्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Preserved.  E. रक्ष् to preserve, pass. v., शानच् aff.
रख्: रख् r. 1st cl. (रखति) also (इ) रखि r. 1st cl. (रङ्खति) To go, to move.
रग्: रग् r. 1st cl. (ए) रगे (रगति) To suspect, to doubt, to fear. r. 10th cl. (रागयति) 	 1. To taste. 	 2. To obtain. (इ) रगि r. 1st cl. (रङ्गति) To go, to move.
रघ्: रघ् (इ) रघि r. 1st cl. (रङ्घते) To go, to move. r. 10th cl. (रङ्घयति-ते) To shine; also without the indicatory letter. r. 10th cl. (रापयति) To taste. KĀLIDĀSA derives रघु from this root.
रघु: रघु m. (-घुः) 	 1. The name of a sovereign of Oudh, the great grand-father of RĀMACHANDRA. 	 2. The family or descendants of RAGHU.  E. लघि to shine, कु Unādi aff., ल changed to र, nasal augment rejected.
रघुकार: रघुकार m. (-रः) The poet KĀLIDĀSA.  E. रघु the race of RAGHU, which forms the subject of a poem by this writer, and कार author.
रघुनन्दन: रघुनन्दन m. (-नः) RĀMA, the second incarnation of VISHṆU, under that appellation.  E. रघु the king RAGHU, नन्दन a son or descendant.
रघुनाथ: रघुनाथ m. (-थः) A name of RĀMA.  E. रघु the race of RAGHU, नाथ lord.
रघुवंश: रघुवंश m. (-शः) The race or family of RAGHU; hence also the name of a poem by KĀLIDĀSA, which treats of the ancestors of RĀMA, from DILĪPA to that prince, and his descendants to AGNIVARṆA; nearly one half relates to the history of RAGHU and as much to that of RĀMA, the remainder is occupied with the remaining princes.  E. रघु as above, and वंश race.
रघुवर: रघुवर m. (-रः) RĀMA.  E. रघु the race of RAGHU, and वर eminent.
रघूद्वह: रघूद्वह m. (-हः) RĀMA.  E. रघु the race of RAGHU, and उद्वह pre-eminent.
रङ्क: रङ्क mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं) 	 1. Niggardly, avaricious, a miser. 	 2. Slow, dull. 3. Hungry.  E. रकि to go, aff. अच् ।
रङ्कु: रङ्कु m. (-ङ्कुः) A sort of deer, (the spotted axis.)  E. रम् to sport, aff. कु, form irr.
रङ्ग: रङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. Paint, colour, tint, dye. 	 2. Dancing, acting, singing, &c. 	 3. A field of battle. 	 4. The place where acting, &c. is exhibi-ted, a stage. 	 5. A place answering to an amphi-theatre. 	 6. An assembly. 	 7. The nasal modification of a vowel. 	 8. Borax. 	 n. (-ङ्गं) Tin.  E. रगि to go, aff. अच्; or रञ्ज् to colour, aff. घञ्, the final changed, and the nasal rejected.
रङ्गचर: रङ्गचर m. (-रः) 	 1. An actor. 	 2. A gladiator.
रङ्गज: रङ्गज n. (-जं) Red lead.  E. रङ्ग colour, ज produced. “सिन्दुरे ।”
रङ्गजीवक: रङ्गजीवक m. (-कः) 	 1. An actor, a dancer, a mine. 	 2. A painter.  E. रङ्ग a stage or colour, &c., and जीवक who lives by.
रङ्गदेवता: रङ्गदेवता f. (-ता) The goddess supposed to preside over sports and diversions.
रङ्गद्वार: रङ्गद्वार n. (-रं) 	 1. A stage-door. 	 2. The prologue of a play.
रङ्गभूति: रङ्गभूति m. (-तिः) The day of full-moon in the month Āshwin, (Septem-ber-October,) on the night of which LAKSHMĪ descended, promising wealth to all who were awake.  E. रङ्ग dancing and singing, भूति being, the night being spent in playing ancient chess, in Nāutches, &c.
रङ्गभूमि: रङ्गभूमि f. (-मिः) 	 1. A field. 	 2. A stage, a theatre, a place where danc-ing is exhibited, or the Indian dramas where represented.  E. रङ्ग dancing, &c., and भूमि ground, spot.
रङ्गमल्ली: रङ्गमल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A lute.  E. रङ्ग् singing, &c., मल्ल् to hold, affs. अच् and ङीष् ।
रङ्गमातृ: रङ्गमातृ f. (-ता) 	 1. A bawd. 	 2. Lac, the animal-dye.  E. रङ्ग passion or colour, &c., and मातृ parent.
रङ्गमातृका: रङ्गमातृका f. (-का) Lac, or the insect which forms the red dye.  E. रङ्ग colour, मातृ parent, कन् added.
रङ्गलासिनी: रङ्गलासिनी f. (-नी) A flower, (Nyctanthes tristis.) “शेफालिकायाम्”. E. रङ्ग colour, (of the stalk,) लस् to shine, aff. णिनि ।
रङ्गवाट: रङ्गवाट m. (-टः) A place enclosed for contest.
रङ्गवीज: रङ्गवीज n. (-जं) Silver.  E. रङ्ग tin, वीज seed or essence.
रङ्गशाला: रङ्गशाला f. (-ला) A hall for public exhibitions, as Nāutches, plays, &c., a ball-room, a theatre.  E. रङ्ग acting, &c., and शाला a hall.
रङ्गाजीव: रङ्गाजीव m. (-वः) 	 1. A painter. 	 2. An actor, a dancer.  E. रङ्ग colour, &c., आजीव who lives by.
रङ्गावतरण: रङ्गावतरण n. (-णं) Acting, playing, exhibiting in public.  E. रङ्ग, अवतरण alighting.
रङ्गावतारक: रङ्गावतारक m. (-कः) 	 1. An actor, a buffoon. 	 2. A boxer. 	 3. A bard or panegyrist.  E. रङ्ग acting, dancing, अव depreciative prefix, तॄ to pass, वुन् aff.; also with णिनि aff., रङ्गावतारिन् ।
रङ्गिन्: रङ्गिन् mfn. (-ङ्गी-ङ्गिणी-ङ्गि) 	 1. Colouring, dying. 	 2. Impassioned, having propensity or passion. 	 f. (-णी) A plant, (Asparagus racemosus.) “शतमूल्याम्”.  E. रङ्ग colour, &c., इनि aff.
रङ्घस्: रङ्घस् n. (-ङ्घः) Speed, volocity: see रंहस्; ह being changed to घ ।
रच्: रच् r. 10th cl. (रचयति-ते) 	 1. To make mechanically, to work, to manu-facture. 	 2. To write, to compose. 	 3. To decorate.
रचक: रचक m. (-कः) A maker, a composer.  E. रच् to make, वुन् aff.
रचना: रचना f. (-ना) 	 1. Orderly and becoming arrangement or disposition in general. 	 2. Decoration or dressing of hair. 	 3. Stringing flowers, &c., weaving wreaths, chaplets, or similar decorations. 	 4. Military array, arrangement of troops. 	 5. Literary composition, whether in verse or prose. 	 6. Suspending garlands, &c. at the doors of a house or building on festival occasions. 	 7. Making or preparing any thing.  E. रच् to make, to manufacture, aff. युच् ।
रचित: रचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Made, manufactured. 	 2. Written, composed. 	 3. Strung.  E. रच् to make, aff. क्त ।
रज: रज mn. (-जः-जं) 	 1. Dust. 	 2. The pollen of flowers. 	 3. The menstrual excretion. 	 4. The second property of humanity, the quality of passion.  E. रन्ज् to colour, &c., aff. अच्, and the nasal rejected; this word more commonly occurs रजस्, q. v.
रजःशय: रजःशय m. (-यः) A dog.  E. रजस् dust, and शय who sleeps.
रजःसारथि: रजःसारथि m. (-थिः) Air, wind.  E. रजस् dust, and सारथि charioteer.
रजक: रजक m. (-कः) 	 1. A washerman. 	 2. Cloth, clothes. 	 f. (-की) A washer-man's wife or a washer-woman.  E. रञ्ज् to colour, (clothes,) ष्वुन् or क्कुन् aff.; or रण्ज्-ण्वुल् न लोपः in the latter case the fem. is रजिका a washer-woman, and रजकी a washer-woman's wife.
रजत: रजत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) White. 	 n. (-तं) 	 1. A pearl-necklace. 	 2. Silver. 	 3. Gold. 	 4. Elephant's teeth, ivory. 	 5. The name of a lake. 	 6. The name of a mountain, perhaps Kailāsa; see रजताद्रि. 	 7. White, (the colour.) 	 8. Blood. 	 9. An asterism, a constellation. 	 10. An ele-phant.  E. रञ्ज् to colour, &c., अतच् Unādi aff.
रजतद्युति: रजतद्युति m. (-तिः) The monkey HANUMĀNA.  E. रजत silver, द्युति lustre.
रजतप्रस्थ: रजतप्रस्थ m. (-स्थः) Mount Kailāsa, the residence of KUVERA and his attendant demi-gods.  E. रजत white, (or silver,) and प्रस्थ table-land.
रजताद्रि: रजताद्रि m. (-द्रिः) Mount Kailāsa,: see the last.  E. रजत, अद्रि mountain.
रजन: रजन n. (-नं) Colouring, dyeing.  E. रञ्ज् to colour, Unādi aff. युक् or क्युन् ।
रजनि: रजनि f. (-निः-नी) 	 1. Night. 	 2. The indigo-plant. 	 3. Turmeric. 	 4. Lac. E. रञ्ज् to colour, अनि Unādi aff., and ङीष् optionally added.
रजनिकर: रजनिकर m. (-रः) The moon.  E. रजनि, and कर who makes; also रजनीकर ।
रजनिंमन्य: रजनिंमन्य Adj. A cloudy day, (looking like a night.)
रजनीगन्ध: रजनीगन्ध m. (-न्धः) The tuberose, (Polianthes tuberosa.)  E. रजनी night, and गन्ध smell, emitting a powerful smell after sun-set.
रजनीचर: रजनीचर m. (-रः) 	 1. A Rākshasa a fiend, a goblin, a ghost. 	 2. A watch-man. 	 3. A thief.  E. रजनी night, चर who goes.
रजनीजल: रजनीजल n. (-लं) Frost, hoar-frost, dew.  E. रजनी night, जल water, fall-ing at night.
रजनीमुख: रजनीमुख n. (-खं) Evening, beginning of the night.  E. रजनी, मुख commencement.
रजनीहासा: रजनीहासा f. (-सा) A flower, (Nyctanthes arbor tristis.) “शेफालिकायाम्”. E. रजनी night, हास a smile; the flowers blossoming at night, and diffusing a powerful scent after sun-set.
रजस्: रजस् n. (-जः) 	 1. The second of the three primary qualities of nature the quality or property of passion: that which produces sensual desire, worldly coveting, pride, and falsehood, and is the cause of pain. 	 2. Dust. 	 3. The dust or pollen of a flower. 	 4. Any particle of matter. 	 5. The menstrual evacuation. 	 6. Cultivated fields. 	 7. A mole in a sun-beam.  E. रञ्ज् to colour, to be attached to, Unādi aff. असुन् ।
रजसानु: रजसानु m. (-नुः) 	 1. A cloud. 	 2. The heart or mind.  E. रञ्ज् to colour, to feel affection for, सानु Unādi aff.
रजस्तमस्क: रजस्तमस्क Adj. Being under the influence of Rajas and Tamas.
रजस्तोक: रजस्तोक mn. (-कः-कं) 	 1. Avarice. 	 2. The child of passion, (a term ap-plied to a person to mark his insignificance.)
रजस्वल: रजस्वल m. (-लः) 	 1. A buffalo. 	 2. Quicksilver. 	 f. (-ला) 	 1. A woman during menstruation. 	 2. A girl, one above ten years of age. 	 3. Dusty. 	 4. Full of passion.  E. रजस् dust, &c., and वलच् aff.
रजित: रजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Affected, moved, attracted, or excited by.  E. रञ्ज् to effect, causal v., क्त aff.
रजोगुण: रजोगुण m. (-णः) The second condition of humanity: see रजस् ।
रजोदर्शन: रजोदर्शन n. (-नं) The first appearance of the menses.
रजोबन्ध: रजोबन्ध m. (-न्धः) Suppression of menstruation.  E. रजस्, and बन्ध binding.
रजोबल: रजोबल n. (-लं) Darkness.  E. रजस् dust, बल heap.
रजोरस: रजोरस n. (-सं) Darkness.  E. रजस् dust, and रस essence, or perhaps this and the preceding should be the same.
रजोहर: रजोहर m. (-रः) A washerman.  E. रजस् dust, dirt, and हर who removes.
रज्जु: रज्जु m. (-ज्जुः) 	 1. A rope, a cord, a tie, a string. 	 2. A lock of braided hair. 	 3. A sinew proceeding from the vertebral column.  E. सृज् to create, &c., Unādi aff. उ, and the radical स rejected, the vowel changed to its semi-vowel.
रञ्ज्: रञ्ज् (औ) औरञ्ज् r. 1st cl. (रजति-ते) r. 4th cl. (रज्यति-ते) To dye, to tinge, to give tint or colour to any thing. r. 1st cl. (रजति) To be attached to, or intent on, to have one's affections or passions engaged by and object. With अनु prefixed. 	 1. To be fond of or attached to, (with a loc.) 	 2. To redden. With अप and वि, To averse, to dislike. With उप, 1. To be eclipsed. 	 2. To suffer calamity. Caus. (रञ्जयति-ते) 1. To colour, to redden. 	 2. To please. 	 3. To conciliate. (रजयति) To hunt deer.
रञ्जक: रञ्जक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. What incites or affects. 	 2. What colours, &c. m. (-कः) 	 1. Colouring, dyeing. 	 2. A colorist, a painter. 	 3. A dyer. 4. A stimulus, an inciter of affection, &c. 	 5. Biliary humour on which vision depends. 	 n. (-कं) 	 1. Vermilion. 	 2. The mendhi-plant, (Lawsonia inermis.)  E. रञ्ज् to colour, वुन् aff. “भल्लातके, काम्पिल्ल वृक्षे च.”
रञ्जन: रञ्जन mn. (-नः-नं) 	 1. Colouring, dyeing, painting, &c. 	 2. Affecting the heart, exciting passion, &c. 	 n. (-नं) Red Sandal or Sappan wood. “वकम्काठ”. 	 f. (-नी) 	 1. The Indigo plant, (Indigofera tinctoria.) 	 2. Bengal madder. 	 3. Another plant, commonly Sundarochani, (a species of Crinum.) “कमलागुंँडि इति भाषा ।” 4. A flower, (Nyctan-thes tristis.)  E. रञ्ज् to colour, aff. युच् or ल्युट् ।
रञ्जित: रञ्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Moved or affected. 	 2. Coloured, dyed, tinted. E. रञ्ज् to colour, क्त aff.
रट्: रट् r. 1st and 10th cl. (रटति रटयति) 	 1. To speak. 	 2. To shout aloud. 	 3. To roar. With आ, to call to.
रटत्: रटत् mfn. (-टन्-टन्ती-टत्) Speaking.  E. रट् to speak, शतृ aff.
रटन: रटन n. (-नं) Speaking, shouting.  E. रट्, and ल्युट् aff.
रटन्ती: रटन्ती f. (-न्ती) The fourteenth of the dark-half of Māgha when bathing is enjoined.  E. रट् to speak, झश् aff., the waters speak.
रटित: रटित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Spoken, said. 	 n. (-तं) The roaring of flame.  E. रट् to speak, aff. क्त ।
रण्: रण् r. 1st cl. (रणति) 	 1. To sound. 	 2. To go, to move.
रण: रण mn. (-णः-णं) War, battle. 	 m. (-णः) 	 1. Sound, noise. 	 2. The quill or bow of a lute, &c. 	 3. Going, moving.  E. रण् to sound, aff. अप् ।
रणकामिन्: रणकामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Desirous of war, wishing to fight.  E. रण, कामिन् who wishes.
रणत्: रणत् mfn. (-णन्-णन्ती-णत्) 	 1. Warring, fighting. 	 2. Going. 	 3. Sounding.  E. रण् to go, शतृ aff.
रणत्कार: रणत्कार m. (-रः) A rutting sound, humming.
रणतूर्य: रणतूर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) A military drum.  E. रण war, तूर्य्य a musical instrument.
रणतूर्य्य: रणतूर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) A military drum.  E. रण war, तूर्य्य a musical instrument.

राजपुष्प: राजपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A plant, (Mesua ferrea.) “नागेश्वर गाछ” ।
राजफणिञ्झक: राजफणिञ्झक m. (-कः) The orange-tree.  E. राज royal, फणिञ्झक a sort of lime.
राजफल: राजफल n. (-लं) A cucumber, (Trichosanthes diœca.)  E. राज royal, and फल fruit.
राजबदर: राजबदर n. (-रं) 	 1. A plant, (a sort of Justicia.) 	 2. Salt. 	 m. (-रः) The jujube.  E. राज royal, and बदर the jujube.
राजभद्रक: राजभद्रक n. (-कं) A sort of costus, (C. speciosus.)  E. राज royal, भद्रक auspicious.
राजभाज्: राजभाज् mfn. (-भाक्) Belonging to or claimed by the king.  E. राज, and भाज् who shares.
राजभूय: राजभूय n. (-यं) Royalty, sovereignty.  E. राज a king, and भूय condition of being.
राजभृत्य: राजभृत्य m. (-त्यः) A courtier, a servant of the king, any public officer. E. राज, and भृत्य a servant.
राजभोग्य: राजभोग्य m. (-ग्यः) A tree, (Chironjia sapida, or Buchanania latifolia, Rox.) “पियालवृक्षे” n. (-ग्यं) Mace.  E. राज royal, and भोग्य enjoyment.
राजभौत: राजभौत m. (-तः) A king's fool or jester.
राजमण्डुक: राजमण्डुक m. (-कः) A large kind of frog.  E. राज a king, मण्डुक a frog.
राजमल्ल: राजमल्ल m. (-ल्लः) A king's wrestler.  E. राज a king, मल्ल a wrestler.
राजमार्ग: राजमार्ग m. (-र्गः) A royal road, one passable for horses and elephants, and forty cubits broad.  E. राज a king, and मार्ग a road.
राजमाष: राजमाष m. (-षः) A kind of bean, (Dolichos Catjang or sinensis.) “वरवटी” E. राज् royal, and माष a sort of kidney-bean.
राजमुद्ग: राजमुद्ग m. (-द्गः) A sort of kidney-bean, (Phaseolus.)  E. राज royal, and मुद्ग P. mungo. “मकुष्ठके, मुग् इति भाषा ।”
राजयक्ष्मन्: राजयक्ष्मन् m. (-क्ष्मा) Pulmonary consumption.  E. राज chief, यक्ष्मन् phthisis.
राजयुध्वन्: राजयुध्वन् m. (-ध्वा) An enemy, a rebel, one making war against a prince. E. राज, युध् to make war, क्वनिप् aff.
राजयोग: राजयोग m. (-गः) 	 1. The configuration of planets at the birth of a man indicating his future king-ship. 	 2. An easy mode of abstract medi-tation, as distinguished from the rigorous one called Hatayoga.
राजयोग्य: राजयोग्य mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) Proper or suitable for a sovereign, princely, royal.  E. राज a king, and योग्य what is fit for.
राजरङ्ग: राजरङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) Silver.  E. राज royal, and रङ्ग tin.
राजराज: राजराज m. (-जः) 	 1. A name of KUVERA. 	 2. An emperor, an universal monarch, or king of kings. 	 3. The moon.  E. राज a king, (of a king or kings,) or a Yaksha, and राज sovereign.
राजर्षि: राजर्षि m. (-र्षिः) A kind of saint; that holy and superhuman personage which a king or man of the military class may become by the practice of religious austerities; seven classes of Rishis are enu-merated, the DeVARSHI, BRAHMARSHI, MAHARSHI, PARAMARSHI, RAJARSHI, KĀṆḌARSHI, and ŚRUTARSHI: the order is variously given, but the RĀJARSHI is inferior to the four preceding ones, and the two last mean the inspired saints and supposed authors of the scriptures.  E. राज king, and ऋषि a saint.
राजलक्षण: राजलक्षण n. (-णं) 	 1. Royal insignia. 	 2. Any natural mark indicating future Kingship, or Hindu royalty.  E. राज, and लक्षण mark.
राजलक्ष्मन्: राजलक्ष्मन् m. (-क्ष्मा) A name of YUDHISHṬHIRA.  E. राज royal, लक्ष्मन् a mark or symbol.
राजलक्ष्मी: राजलक्ष्मी f. (-क्ष्मी) The prosperity of a king.
राजलेख: राजलेख m. (-खः) A royal letter or order.  E. राज, and लेख a writing; also राजलेख्यं, &c.
राजवंश्य: राजवंश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) Of royal parentage or descent.  E. राज royal, वंश family, यत् aff.
राजवत्: राजवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 	 1. Governed by a just and able monarch, (a country, &c.) 	 2. Royal, kingly.  E. राज a king, and मतुप् aff.
राजवर्त्मन्: राजवर्त्मन् n. (-र्त्म) A royal or main road.  E. राज a king, and वर्त्मन् a road.
राजवला: राजवला f. (-ला) A plant, (Pæderia fœtida.)  E. राज a king, and वल sur-rounding. “गन्धभादुलिया” ।
राजवल्ली: राजवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A small gourd, (Momordica charantia.) “कारवेल्लके” E. राज royal, वल्ली a creeper.
राजवसति: राजवसति f. (-तिः) 	 1. A throne. 	 2. A palace.  E. राज, and वसति abode.
राजवाह: राजवाह m. (-हः) A horse.  E. राज a king, and वाह a vehicle.
राजवाह्य: राजवाह्य m. (-ह्यः) A royal elephant.  E. राज a king, and वाह्य a vehicle.
राजवि: राजवि m. (-विः) The blue-jay.  E. राज, and वि a bird.
राजविद्या: राजविद्या f. (-द्या) Kingcraft, state policy, statesmanship.
राजवीजिन्: राजवीजिन् mfn. (-जी-जिनी-जि) Springing from a royal race.  E. राज a king, वीज seed, and इनि aff.
राजवृक्ष: राजवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) 	 1. The Piyāla tree, (Buchanania latifolia.) 	 2. A sort of tree, (Cassia fistula.) “सोन्दाल”. 	 3. Euphorbia of various kinds. E. राज royal, and वृक्ष a tree.
राजशण: राजशण m. (-णः) A plant, from the fibres of which a coarse cordage and canvas are prepared, (Corchorus capsularis or olitorius.)  E. राज royal, and शण Crotolaria. “पाट गाछ” इति भाषा ।
राजशय्या: राजशय्या f. (-य्या) A royal seat or throne.  E. राज a king, and शय्या a bed or couch.
राजशासन: राजशासन n. (-नं) 	 1. A royal edict. 	 2. A royal badge.  E. राज and शासन an edict.
राजशुक: राजशुक m. (-कः) A sort of parrot, (Psittacus Lori.) “मयनापाखी”.  E. राज royal, and शुक a parrot.
राजशृङ्ग: राजशृङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) The royal Chhātta or umbrella. 	 m. (-ङ्गः) A sort of sheat fish, (Silurus batachus.) “मागुरमाछ”.  E. राज royal, शृङ्ग a horn.
राजस: राजस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Relating to, or derived, &c. from the quality of Rajas or passion. 	 f. (-सी) 	 1. The goddess DURGĀ. 	 2. The state of being in this world or the next, in which the Raja Guṇa or quality of passion predominates: it is divided into three classes: the first class comprises the Gandharbas, Yakshas, Guhyakas, &c.; the second king and heroes, and the third, boxers, wrestlers, gamb-lers, tipplers, actors, &c.  E. रजस् the quality of passion, अण् and ङीप् affs.
राजसत्ता: राजसत्ता f. (-त्ता) Majesty, royal dignity.  E. राज, and सत्ता existence.
राजसदन: राजसदन n. (-नं) A palace.  E. राज a king, and सदन a dwelling.
राजसफर: राजसफर m. (-रः) The Iliśa or Hilsā fish, (Clupanodon Ilisha, HAM.) E. राज king, and सफर another sort of fish.
राजसभा: राजसभा f. (-भा) A royal assembly or court.  E. राज a king, सभा assembly.
राजसर्प: राजसर्प m. (-र्पः) A large kind of snake, (Boa.)  E. राज, and सर्प a snake; the king of snakes. “राजसाप” ।
राजसर्षप: राजसर्षप m. (-पः) 	 1. Mustard, (Sinapis dichotoma, or S. ramosa, Rox.) 2. A mustard seed, as a measure of weight.  E. राज royal, सर्षप mustard.
राजसायुज्य: राजसायुज्य n. (-ज्यं) Royalty, sovereignty.  E. राज a king, सायुज्य state.
राजसारस: राजसारस m. (-सः) A peacock.  E. राज royal, and सारस the Indian crane.
राजसिंह: राजसिंह m. (-हः) A great king.  E. राज, and सिंह a lion.
राजसूय: राजसूय n. (-यं) 	 1. A sacrifice performed only by an universal monarch, attended by his tributary princes; as in the case of YUDHISHṬHIRA, and others. 	 2. A lotus. 	 3. A mountain. 	 4. A sort of rice.  E. राज a king, (by him,) and षू to be produced, to be effected, aff. क्यप्; or राज the moon, for the moon-plant of which the acid-juice is drank at the ceremony, and सु to bring forth, the same aff., deriv. irr.
राजसूयक: राजसूयक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to a royal sacrifice.  E. कन् added to the last.
राजसूययाजिन्: राजसूययाजिन् m. (-जी) A priest officiating at the royal sacrifice. E. राजसूय, and याजिन् who sacrifices.
राजसेवक: राजसेवक m. (-कः) A courtier, a royal attendant.  E. राज, and सेवक a servant.
राजस्कन्ध: राजस्कन्ध m. (-न्धः) A horse.  E. राज a king, and स्कन्ध the shoulder.
राजस्व: राजस्व n. (-स्वं) Royal revenue, impost, duty, tax.  E. राज, and स्व own.
राजहंस: राजहंस m. (-सः) 	 1. A white goose with red legs and bill, or more proper-ly perhaps the flamingo. 	 2. A drake. 	 3. An excellent king.  E. राज, and हंस a goose, the king-goose.
राजहर्षण: राजहर्षण n. (-णं) A city, a town.  E. राज a king, and हर्षण delighting.
राजहस्तिन्: राजहस्तिन् m. (-स्ती) A royal elephant.  E. राज, and हस्तिन् an elephant.
राजहासक: राजहासक m. (-कः) A sort of large fish, (Cyprinus niloticus.) “कात्लामाछ” E. राज a king, हासक diverting, pleasing.
राजाज्ञा: राजाज्ञा f. (-ज्ञा) A royal edict or command.  E. राज and आज्ञा order.
राजातन: राजातन m. (-नः) A tree, (Buchanania latifolia.) “पीतशालवृक्षे”.  E. राज a king, and आङ् before, तन् to stretch, aff. अच् ।
राजादन: राजादन m. (-नः) 	 1. A tree, (Bachanania latifolia.) 	 2. Another tree, (Mimusops kauki.) “क्षीरिणीवृक्षे”. 	 3. The Kinśuka, (Butea frondosa.) E. राज a king, अदन eating; also राजातन, and राजादनफल ।
राजाधिराज: राजाधिराज m. (-जः) A paramount sovereign.  E. राजा, अधिराज superior prince.
राजान्न: राजान्न m. (-न्नः) A sort of rice, of a superior quality, said to grow in the Āndhra country.  E. राज, and अन्न food.
राजाम्र: राजाम्र m. (-म्रः) A superior sort of mango.  E. राज royal, अम्र mango.
राजाम्ल: राजाम्ल m. (-म्लः) A kind of dock or sorrel: see अम्लवेतस ।
राजार्क: राजार्क m. (-र्कः) Gigantic swallow wort, (Asclepias gigantea, with white flowers.)  E. राज royal, and अर्क swallow wort. “श्वेतआकन्दे” ।
राजार्ह: राजार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) Royal, noble, fit or proper for a king. 	 n. (-र्हं) Aloe-wood, (Amyris agallochum, Rox.) “अगुरुकाष्ठे”.  E. राज a sover-eign, and अर्ह proper.
राजालुक: राजालुक m. (-कः) An esculent root, a sort of yam. “रशुने”.  E. राज royal, आलु a yam, कन् added.
राजावर्त: राजावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A gem, described as an inferior kind of diamond, brought from the country Birāta.  E. राज a king, आवर्त्त a turning; it is considered as a lucky possession for princes, though not es-teemed as an ornament.
राजावर्त्त: राजावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A gem, described as an inferior kind of diamond, brought from the country Birāta.  E. राज a king, आवर्त्त a turning; it is considered as a lucky possession for princes, though not es-teemed as an ornament.
राजावलि: राजावलि f. (-लिः-ली) A line of kings, a royal dynasty or genealogy. E. राज and आवली a line.
राजाहि: राजाहि m. (-हिः) A sort of snake said to be two-headed.  E. राज royal, अहि a snake.
राजि: राजि f. (-जिः-जी) 	 1. A row, a line. 	 2. An unbroken row, a continuous line. 	 3. A small vessel of the body.  E. राज् to shine, इन् Unādi aff., ङीष् optionally added.
राजिका: राजिका f. (-का) 	 1. Black mustard, (Sinapis racemosa, Rox.) 	 2. A field. 3. A line, a row, a range. 	 4. A continuous or unbroken line. E. राज to shine, क्वुन् aff., fem. form; or राजि as above, कन् added.
राजित: राजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Adorned, embellished. 	 2. Illuminated, irradia-ted.  E. राज to shine, क्त aff.
राजिल: राजिल m. (-लः) A sort of snake, (Amphisbæna.) “ढ्ॐडासाप”.  E. राजि a line, लच् aff.
राजीव: राजीव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Attending on or living about a prince. 	 m. (-वः) 	 1. A large fish, (Cyprinus niloticus, BUCH.) 	 2. A kind of deer. 	 3. An elephant. 	 n. (-वं) A lotus, (Nelumbium speciosum.)  E. राजी a line, a row, व aff.
राजेन्द्र: राजेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) An emperor.  E. राज, and इन्द्र chief.
राजेभ: राजेभ m. (-भः) A state elephant.  E. राज, and इभ an elephant.
राजेय: राजेय m. (-यः) A kind of cucumber: see पटोल ।
राज्ञी: राज्ञी f. (-ज्ञी) A queen. नील्यां, कांस्ये, जातीपुष्यवृक्षे, पित्तलेच ।
राज्य: राज्य n. (-ज्यं) 	 1. A government, a country, a principality, a kingdom. 2. Administration or exercise of sovereignty or government. E. राज for राजन् a prince, and यत् or यक् aff.
राज्यच्युत: राज्यच्युत m. (-तः) A prince who has lost his kingdom.  E. राज्य, and च्युत fallen from.
राज्यच्युति: राज्यच्युति f. (-तिः) Deposal, loss of sovereignty.  E. राज्य, and च्युति falling.
राज्यतन्त्र: राज्यतन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) Science of government, system of administration.
राज्यधुरा: राज्यधुरा f. (-रा) Administration, burden or yoke of government. E. राज्य, धुरा burthen.
राज्यभङ्ग: राज्यभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Subversion of sovereignty.  E. राज्य and भङ्ग breaking.
राज्यभाज्: राज्यभाज् m. (-भाक्) A king.  E. राज्य, and भाज् who has.
राज्यभ्रंश: राज्यभ्रंश m. (-शः) 	 1. Deposal or loss of a kingdom.  E. राज्य and भ्रंश falling.
राज्यभ्रष्ट: राज्यभ्रष्ट m. (-ष्टः) A deposed sovereign.  E. राज्य, भ्रष्ट fallen.
राज्यरक्षा: राज्यरक्षा f. (-क्षा) Protection or defence of a kingdom.  E. राज्य, रक्षा preservation.
राज्यलोभ: राज्यलोभ m. (-भः) Ambition.  E. राज्य and लोभ desire.
राज्याङ्ग: राज्याङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) A requisite of regal administration; variously enu-merated, as seven, eight, or nine, viz.:--first, the monarch; second, the prime minister; third, a friend or ally; fourth, trea-sure; fifth territory; sixth a strong-hold; and seventh, an army; the eighth is the population or companies of citizens, and the ninth the Purohita or spiritual adviser.  E. राज्य royalty, and अङ्ग limb or part.
राज्याधिकार: राज्याधिकार m. (-रः) 	 1. Government of a kingdom. 	 2. Right or title to a sovereignty.  E. राज्य and अधिकार superintendance, &c.
राज्याभिषेक: राज्याभिषेक m. (-कः) Inauguration of a king.
राटि: राटि f. (-टिः) War, battle.  E. रट् to speak, to sound, aff. ङीप् ।
राढा: राढा f. (-ढा) 	 1. Beauty, splendour, light, lustre. 	 2. A country or dis-trict, part of Bengal to the west of the Hugli-river.  E. रह to quit, aff. घञ्, and ह changed to ढ ।
राण: राण n. (-णं) 	 1. A leaf. 	 2. A peacock's tail.  E. रण् to sound, aff. घञ् ।
रात्रक: रात्रक n. (-कं) A period of five nights collectively. 	 m. (-कः) A man who takes up his abode in a harlot's house for one year.  E. रात्रि night, and कन् aff.
रात्रि: रात्रि f. (-त्रिः-त्री) Night, the darkness of night.  E. रा to give, (pleasure or rest,) त्रिप् Unādi aff., ङीप् optionally added.
रात्रिचर: रात्रिचर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Going or moving at night. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A goblin, a fiend, a ghost or evil spirit. 	 2. A thief, a robber. 	 3. A guard, a patrole.  E. रात्रि night, (by night,) and चर who goes.
रात्रिचर्या: रात्रिचर्या f. (-र्या) 	 1. Night-roving. 	 2. A nightly act or ceremony.
रात्रिज: रात्रिज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Nocturnal, born or produced at night. 	 n. (-जं) A star, a constellation.  E. रात्रि night, and ज born.
रात्रिजल: रात्रिजल n. (-लं) Dew, mist, fog.  E. रात्रि night, and जल water.
रात्रिजागर: रात्रिजागर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Keeping watch at night, sitting up at night. m. (-रः) A dog.  E. रात्रि night, and जागर who wakes.
रात्रिजागरण: रात्रिजागरण n. (-णं) Sitting up all night.  E. रात्रि, and जागरण waking.
रात्रिजागरद: रात्रिजागरद m. (-दः) A musquito, a gnat.  E. रात्रिजागर waking by night, and द who gives or makes, from दा to give, or from दो to cut, who stings.
रात्रिञ्चर: रात्रिञ्चर m. (-रः) A ghost, a goblin.  E. रात्रि night, चर् to go, ट aff., मुम् aug.; also रात्रिचर ।
रात्रितरा: रात्रितरा f. (-रा) The dead of night.
रात्रिपुष्प: रात्रिपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) A lotus-flower opening at night.
रात्रिमट: रात्रिमट m. (-टः) 	 1. A ghost, a goblin. 	 2. A thief. 	 3. A guard. 	 4. A night-walker.  E. रात्रि night, अट् to go, aff. अच्, and मुम् augment.
रात्रिमणि: रात्रिमणि m. (-णिः) The moon.  E. रात्रि night, मणि a jewel.
रात्रिम्मन्य: रात्रिम्मन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Thinking it night.  E. रात्रि, मन्य who believes, खच् aff.
रात्रियोग: रात्रियोग m. (-गः) Coming on of night.  E. रात्रि, and योग joining.
रात्रिवासस्: रात्रिवासस् n. (-सः) 	 1. Night-dress. 	 2. Darkness.  E. रात्रि night, and वासस् vesture.
रात्रिविगम: रात्रिविगम m. (-मः) Dawn, day-light.  E. रात्रि night, विगम stop, cessation.
रात्रिविश्लेषगामिन्: रात्रिविश्लेषगामिन् m. (-मी) The ruddy-goose.  E. रात्रि night, विश्लेष separa-tion, and गामिन् who goes: these birds being supposed to pass the night apart. “चक्रवाकपक्षिणि” ।
रात्रिवेद: रात्रिवेद m. (-दः) A cock.  E. रात्रि night, वेद who knows, its measure or duration.
रात्रिवेदिन्: रात्रिवेदिन् m. (-दी) A cock.  E. रात्रि night, वेदिन् who knows: see the last.
रात्रिहास: रात्रिहास m. (-सः) The white lotus.  E. रात्रि night, and हास what smiles, blossoming at night. “श्वेतोत्पले” ।
रात्रिहिण्डक: रात्रिहिण्डक m. (-कः) A guard of the interior or women's apartments.  E. रात्रि, हिडि to go, क्कुन् aff.
रात्र्यट: रात्र्यट m. (-टः) 	 1. An imp, a goblin. 	 2. A ghost. 	 3. A thief. 	 4. A night-walker.  E. रात्रि, अट् to go, aff. अच्; also with nasal inserted, रात्रिमट ।
राद्ध: राद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 	 1. Cooked, dressed. 	 2. Perfected, as a religious vow; observed, as a fast, &c. 	 3. Perfect, in mysterious or magical power, adept, initiated. 	 4. Perfect in general, accomplished, mature, &c. 	 5. Successful, fortunate. 	 6. Propitiated, conciliated. E. राध् to accomplish or be accomplished, aff. क्त ।
राद्धान्त: राद्धान्त m. (-न्तः) Demonstrated truth, proved and established fact or conclusion, a dogma.  E. राद्ध established, अन्त end, result.
राध्: राध्(औ)औराध r. 4th cl. (राध्यति) 	 1. To be favourable or merciful. 	 2. To be ready, to be successful. 	 3. To kill. With अनु or आ, To propitiate, to adore. With अप, (usually used with a loc., but sometimes with a gen.) 	 1. To offend, to miss, to err. 	 2. To injure. With वि, To injure, to offend, to hurt. Caus. (रोधयति-ते) With आ, 1. To please. 	 2. To serve. r. 5th cl. (राध्नोति) 	 1. To bring anything to fulness or completion, to finish, to effect, to accomplish, to complete. 	 2. To attain completion, to succeed, to be finished or accomplished. 	 3. To destroy. With अप prefixed, To offend, to be in fault. With आङ्, To worship, to propitiate by worship.
राध: राध m. (-धः) The month Vaiśākha, (April-May.) 	 f. (-धा) 	 1. The asterism, in which the moon is full in the month Vaiśākha; the sixteenth of the Nakshatras, containing four stars in the shape of a festoon. 	 2. A celebrated Gopi, the favourite mistress of KRISH-ṆA, during his residence in Brindāvana amongst the cow-herds. 	 3. Name of the foster mother of KARṆA. 	 4. Prosperity. 	 5. Lightning. 	 6. An attitude in shooting, standing with the feet a span apart. 	 7. Emblic myrobalan. 	 8. A flower, (Clitoria ternata.) E. राध् to accomplish, aff. अच्, fem. aff. टाप्; or राधा the asterism, अण् aff. of reference.
राधन: राधन n. (-नं) 	 1. Completing, accomplishing, succeeding, effecting. 	 2. Obtaining, acquisition. 	 3. Pleasure, satisfaction. 	 4. The means or instrument of accomplishing any thing. 	 f. (-ना) Speech, speaking. E. राध् to accomplish, aff. ल्युट् or युच् ।
राधरङ्क: राधरङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 	 1. A plough. 	 2. Thin-rain. 	 3. Hail.
राधाकान्त: राधाकान्त m. (-न्तः) A name of KRISHṆA.  E. राधा, and कान्त beloved.
राधातनय: राधातनय m. (-यः) KARṆA.  E. राधा, and तनय son; see राधासुत ।
राधानाथ: राधानाथ m. (-थः) A name of KRISHṆA.  E. राधा, and नाथ lord.
राधापुत्त्र: राधापुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) KARṆA.  E. राधा, and पुत्त्र son: see राधासुत ।
राधाभेदिन्: राधाभेदिन् m. (-दी) A name of ARJUNA.  E. राधा the mistress of KRISHṆA, and भेदिन् dividing; having prevailed on KRISHṆA to abandon her.
राधावल्लभ: राधावल्लभ m. (-भः) A name of KRISHṆA.  E. राधा, and वल्लभ beloved.
राधावेधिन्: राधावेधिन् m. (-धी) ARJUNA.  E. राधा the mistress of KRISHṆA, and वेधिन् who hurts or wounds: see राधाभेदिन् ।
राधासुत: राधासुत m. (-तः) KARṆA.  E. राधा the name of the wife of the charioteer of DHRITARĀSHTRA, (by whom the prince, after exposure by his own mother KUNTĪ, was found and fostered,) and सुत a son.
राधेय: राधेय m. (-यः) A name of KARṆA.  E. राधा a proper name, ढक् aff.
राप्य: राप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) To be said or spoken.  E. रप् to speak, aff. ण्यत् ।
राम: राम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 	 1. Black. 	 2. White. 	 3. Beautiful, pleasing. 	 m. (-मः) 1. A name common to three incarnations of VISHṆU, viz:-firstly, PARAŚURĀMA, the son of the Muni JAMADAGNI, born at the com-mencement of the second or TRETA YUGA, for the purpose of punishing the tyrannical kings of the Kshetriya race. Secondly, RĀMACHANDRA, the son of DAŚARATHA, king of Oudh, born at the close of the second age, to destroy the demons who infested the earth, and especially RĀVAṆA the Daitya-sovereign of Ceylon. Thirdly, BALARĀMA, (the elder and half-brother of KRISHṆA,) the son of BĀSUDEVA by ROHINI, born at the end of the DWĀPARA or third age. 	 2. A name of VARUṆA, regent of the waters. 	 3. A horse. 	 4. A sort of deer. 	 f. (-मा) 	 1. A woman, a female, a plea-sing or beautiful female. 	 2. Asafœtida. 	 3. A river. 	 4. Vermilion. n. (-मं) 	 1. A potherb, (Chenopodium album.) 	 2. A sort of Costus, (C. speciosus.)  E. रम् to sport, aff. घञ् ।
रामकरी: रामकरी f. (-री) One of the Rāgīnis, or female personifications of the musical modes.  E. राम delighting, करी who makes; also रामकली ।
रामकर्पूर: रामकर्पूर m. (-रः) A fragrant sort of grass.  E. राम pleasant, and कर्पूर (smelling like,) camphor.
रासकली: रासकली f. (-ली) A Rāgīni.  E. राम pleasant, कला sound or note, ङीप् aff.
रामगिरि: रामगिरि m. (-रिः) The name of a mountain, variously applied, but espe-cially assigned to a mountain called COMPTEH or CHITRAKŪṬA in BUNDELKHUND, and to another near NĀGPORE, called now RĀMTEK. E. राम the hero RĀMA, and गिरि a mountain; being one of his halting places in his progress from Oudh to the Peninsula.
रामचन्द्र: रामचन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) The hero RĀMACHANDRA, the son of DASARATHA. E. राम and चन्द्र the moon, the moon-like RĀMA.
रामजननी: रामजननी m. (-नी) The mother of BALARĀMA.  E. राम and जननी mother, hence it is equally applicable to RENUKĀ, the mother of PARAŚURĀMA, and to KAUŚALYA, the mother of RĀMACHANDRA.
रामठ: रामठ n. (-ठं) Asafœtida.  E. रम् to please, अठ Unādi aff., and the radi-cal vowel lengthened.
रामणीयक: रामणीयक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Beautiful, pleasing.  E. रमणीय the same, and वुञ् aff.
रामदूत: रामदूत m. (-तः) The monkey HANUMĀNA, the friend and messenger of RAMĀ. 	 f. (-तिः-ती) A shrub, apparently a variety of basil with small leaves. “नाग्दोना”.  E. राम RĀMA, and दूत a messenger.
रामनवमी: रामनवमी f. (-मी) The ninth day in the light-half of Chaitra, the anni-versary of the birth of RĀMACHANDRA.
रामपूग: रामपूग m. (-गः) A small species of the areca or betel-nut tree, (Areca triandra, Rox.)  E. राम RĀMA, पूग areca.
रामभद्र: रामभद्र m. (-द्रः) The hero RĀMACHANDRA.  E. राम the same, and भद्र auspicious.
रामवीणा: रामवीणा f. (-णा) A sort of Vina or lute.  E. राम RĀMA and वीणा a lute; it may be also ironically applicable to the horn blown by BALA-RĀMA, and called still the RĀMASINHĀ.
रामशर: रामशर m. (-रः) A variety of the Saccharum Sara, a sort of grass.
रामसख: रामसख m. (-खः) The monkey-king SUGRIVA.  E. राम RĀMA, and सख friend; RĀMA having restored him to his throne, whence he had been driven by his elder brother BĀLI.
रामसेतु: रामसेतु m. (-तुः) A bridge of sand, now a chain of islands, between the Indian Peninsula and Ceylon, popularly known by “Adam's bridge”.
रामायण: रामायण n. (-णं) 	 1. The first epic poem of the Hindus, written by the poet VĀLMIKI, recording the adventures of RĀMA, the son of DAŚA RATHA, sovereign of Oudh. 	 2. A name of several poems on the life and adventures of RĀMA.  E. राम the prince, and अयन abode.
रामानुज: रामानुज m. (-जः) Name of the founder of a Vedāntic sect.
रामिल: रामिल m. (-लः) 	 1. KĀMA or CUPID. 	 2. A lover, a husband.  E. राम pleasing, agreeable, इलच् aff.
राम्भ: राम्भ m. (-म्भः) The bamboo staff of a religious student.  E. रम्भा a bamboo, aff. अञ् ।
रायण: रायण n. (-णं) 	 1. Pain. 	 2. Sounding, crying.  E. रै to sound, aff. ल्युट् ।
रायभाटी: रायभाटी f. (-टी) The current or flow of a river.
रारस्यमान: रारस्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Crying aloud and repeatedly.  E. रस to cry, reit. v., शानच् aff.
राल: राल m. (-लः) Resin, the resinous and fragrant exudation of the Shorea robusta. “धुना”.  E. रा to give or get, aff. अलच्; also अराल ।
राव: राव m. (-वः) Sound, noise.  E. रु to cry or sound, aff. घञ् ।
रावण: रावण m. (-णः) The Daitya-sovereign of Lankā or Ceylon, killed by RĀMACHANDRA. 	 n. (-णं) Noise, tumult.  E. रु to cry, (in the causal form,) aff. ल्युट; afflicting mankind.
रावणारि: रावणारि m. (-रिः) The hero RĀMA.  E. रावण, अरि the foe.
रावणि: रावणि m. (-णिः) The eldest son of RĀVAṆA.  E. रावण, इञ् patronymic aff.
राश्: राश्(ऋ)राशृ r. 1st and 4th cl. (राशते राश्यते) To sound.
राशि: राशि m. (-शिः) 	 1. A heap, a quantity. 	 2. A sign of the zodiac. 	 3. Arith-metical or algebraic quantity. 	 4. A part and its divisor or nu-merator and denominator. 	 5. A congeries of number or quantity. E. अश् to pervade, इण् Unādi aff., and रुट् initial augment; or रश् to sound, with the same aff.
राशिगत: राशिगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Heaped, accumulated. 	 2. Computed, sum-med either by arithmetic or algebra.  E. राशि, and गत gone to.
राशिचक्र: राशिचक्र n. (-क्रं) The zodiac.  E. राशि, a sign, and चक्र a wheel or circle.
राशित्रय: राशित्रय n. (-यं) The rule of three.
राशिभाग: राशिभाग m. (-गः) A fraction.  E. राशि, भाग a part.
राशिभोग: राशिभोग m. (-गः) Passage of a planet through a sign of the zodiac. E. राशि, भोग enjoyment.
राशीकरण: राशीकरण n. (-णं) Heaping, piling, gathering.  E. राशि, करण making, च्वि augment.
राशीकृत: राशीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Heaped, piled, &c.  E. राशि, कृत made, च्वि aug.
राशीभूत: राशीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Heaped, piled.  E. राशि, and भूत become, च्वि aug.
राष्ट्र: राष्ट्र mn. (-ष्ट्रः-ष्ट्रं) 	 1. An inhabited country or realm, a region. 	 2. Any public calamity, as plague, famine, &c.  E. राज् to shine or govern, aff. ष्ट्रन् ।
राष्ट्रनिवासिन्: राष्ट्रनिवासिन् m. (-सी) An inhabitant of any civilized country.  E. राष्ट्र a district, निवासिन् a dweller.
राष्ट्रिक: राष्ट्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Bolonging to or inhabiting a country. 	 f. (-का) A prickly sort of night-shade, (Solanum jacquini.) “कण्टकारी”.  E. राष्ट्र a country, and ठन् aff.
राष्ट्रिय: राष्ट्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Of or belonging to a kingdom, produced or born in it, &c.  E. राष्ट्र a region, घ aff.
राष्ट्रीय: राष्ट्रीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Belonging or relating to a region or realm. 	 m. (-यः) A king's brother-in-law, (in theatrical language.)  E. राष्ट्र a region, छ aff.
रास्: रास्(ऋ)रासृ r. 1st cl. (रासते) To sound, to cry.
रास: रास m. (-सः) 	 1. Confused noise, uproar, hubbub. 	 2. Sound in general. 	 3. Speech, discourse. 	 4. A chain. 	 5. A festival amongst the cowherds, including songs and dances, especially the circular dance as per-formed by KRISHṆA and the Gopis or cowherdesses. 	 6. A game played by children.  E. रास् to sound, घञ् aff.
रासक: रासक n. (-कं) A kind of minor drama in one act.
रासभ: रासभ m. (-भः) An ass. 	 f. (-भी) The she-ass.  E. रास् to sound, अभच Unādi aff.
रासभधूसर: रासभधूसर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Grey or light-brown, ass-grey.  E. रासभ, धूसर grey.
रासभवन्दिनी: रासभवन्दिनी f. (-नी) Arabian jasmine.  E. रासभ an ass, वदि to praise, aff. णिनि ।
रासयात्रा: रासयात्रा f. (-त्रा) A festival held in honour of KRISHṆA on the full-moon of Kārtika.  E. रास, and यात्रा festival.
रासेरस: रासेरस m. (-सः) 	 1. An assembly, a company, a party. 	 2. A game or festival peculiar to the cowherds: see रास. 	 3. Love, desire, the passion or sentiment. 	 4. Alchemy: see रससिद्धि. 	 5. The sixth night after delivery, on which the family and friends sit up all night. 6. Sport, mirth, pastime. 	 7. Any festival or holiday.  E. रास noise, &c., and रस flavour, taste.
रास्ना: रास्ना f. (-स्ना) 	 1. A plant, (Mimosa octandra.) 	 2. Another plant, (the ser-pent ophioxylon.) 	 3. A sort of perfume.  E. रस् to sound, नक् Unādi aff., and the vowel made long.
राहित्य: राहित्य n. (-त्यं) The being without anything, destitution.
राहु: राहु m. (-हुः) The ascending node; in mythology, the son of VIPRACHITTI by SINHIKĀ, a Daitya, with the tail of a dragon, whose head was severed from his body by VISHṆU, on the information of the sun and the moon who caught him in the act of drinking Amrita which was being served to gods, but being immortal by tasting it, his head and tail retained their separate existence, and being transferred to the stellar sphere, became the authors of eclipses; the first especially, by endeavouring at various times to swallow the sun and the moon to wreak his vengeance.  E. रह् to abandon, (the planets which it has vainly attempted to devour,) aff. उण्, and the vowel made long.
राहुग्रस्त: राहुग्रस्त m. (-स्तः) Eclipsed, (as the sun or moon.)  E. राहु, and ग्रस्त seized.
राहुग्रास: राहुग्रास m. (-सः) Immersion of a planet in an eclipse.  E. राहु, and ग्रास mouthful.
राहुग्राह: राहुग्राह m. (-हः) An eclipse of the sun or moon.  E. राहु the dragon's head, ग्राह seizure.
राहुभेदिन्: राहुभेदिन् m. (-दी) VISHṆU.  E. राहु the Daitya, भेदिन् the divider.
राहुमूर्द्धभिद्: राहुमूर्द्धभिद् m. (-भित्) VISHṆU.  E. राहु the Daitya, मूर्द्ध the head, and भिद् who divides, who decapitates.
राहुलसू: राहुलसू m. (-सूः) A name of the legislator Buddha or Sākyasingha.
राहुसंस्पर्श: राहुसंस्पर्श m. (-र्शः) An eclipse.  E. राहु the dragon's head, and संस्पर्श seizure, contact.
राहुसूतक: राहुसूतक n. (-कं) The birth of RĀHU. i. e. an eclipse.
राहुहन्: राहुहन् m. (-हा) VISHṆU.  E. राहु the Daitya, हन् destroyer.
राहूच्छिष्ट: राहूच्छिष्ट m. (-ष्टः) Garlic.  E. राहु the demon, उच्छिष्ट vomited.
राहूत्सृष्ट: राहूत्सृष्ट m. (-ष्टः) Garlic.  E. राहु the Daitya, उत्सृष्ट created. “रशोने” ।
रि: रि r. 5th cl. (रिणोति) To hurt or injure. r. 6th cl. (रियति) To go, to move.

रोहि: रोहि m. (-हिः) 	 1. A tree. 	 2. A seed. 	 3. A pious or religious man, one observing a vow, &c. 	 4. A kind of deer. “वनरोह इति भाषा ।”  E. रुह् to grow, Unādi aff. इन् ।
रोहिण: रोहिण m. (-णः) 	 1. The Indian-fig tree. 	 2. A fragrant grass. 	 n. (-णं) A part of the fore-noon, extending to mid-day, in which Shrāddhas are especially to be observed.  E. रुह् to grow, Unādi aff. इनन् ।
रोहिणिका: रोहिणिका f. (-का) A woman red with anger, &c., or with red pigments. E. रोहिणी fem. form of रोहित red, कन् added.
रोहिणीपति: रोहिणीपति m. (-तिः) The moon.  E. रोहिणी the nymph, (see रोहिन्,) पति husband.
रोहिणीवल्लभ: रोहिणीवल्लभ m. (-भः) The moon.  E. रोहिणी the nymph, वल्लभ the lover.
रोहिणीश: रोहिणीश m. (-शः) The moon.  E. रोहिणी the nymph, ईश lord or husband.
रोहित्: रोहित् m. (-हित्) The sun. 	 f. (-हित्) 	 1. A deer, a doe. 	 2. A sort of cree-per.  E. रुह् to go or grow, Unādi aff. इतच् ।
रोहित: रोहित mfn. (-रोहितः रोहिता or रोहिणी रोहितं) Red, of a red colour. 	 m. (-तः) 1. Red, (the colour.) 	 2. The Rohi-fish, (Cyprinus Rohita, HAM.) 3. A kind of deer. 	 4. A tree, (Andersonia Rohitaka, Rox.) 	 n. (-तं) 1. INDRA'S bow unbent and invisible to mortals. 	 2. Safflower, (Carthamus tinctorius.) 	 3. Blood.  E. रुह् to grow or go, Unādi aff. इतच् ।
रोहितक: रोहितक m. (-कः) A tree, (Andersonia Rohitaka, Rox.)  E. कन् added to the preceding.
रोहितश्व: रोहितश्व m. (-श्वः) 	 1. A name of Agni. 	 2. The son of HARIŚCHANDRA. E. रोहित् a deer, or red, and अश्व a horse; also from रोहित sometimes read रोहिताश्व ।
रोहितिका: रोहितिका f. (-का) A woman whose face is stained with red pigments, or who is red with rage, &c.  E. रोहित red, fem. form, कन् added.
रोहितेय: रोहितेय m. (-यः) A tree, (Andersonia Rohitaka.) “रोहितक वृक्षे”.  E. रोहित the same. ढक् pleonastic aff.
रोहिन्: रोहिन् m. (-ही) 	 1. The Indian-fig tree. 	 2. The holy-fig tree. 	 3. The Andersonia Rohitaka. 	 f. (-हिणिः-हिणी) 	 1. The fourth lunar asterism, figured by a wheeled carriage, and containing five stars, probably; in mythology, the asterism is personified as one of the daughters of Daksha, and wives of the moon. 	 2. The mother of BALARĀMA. 	 f. (-णी) 	 1. One of the VIDYĀDEVIS of the Jainas. 	 2. A cow. 	 3. Inflam-matory affection of the throat. 	 4. Lightning. 	 5. The name of a medicinal plant. 	 6. The moon-plant, (Asclepias acida.) 	 7. A woman stained with red pigments, or red with passion, &c. 	 8. Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.) 	 9. Bengal madder. 	 10. A girl nine years old.  E. रुह् to grow, aff. णिनि ।
रोहिष: रोहिष n. (-षं) A sort of grass. 	 m. (-षः) 	 1. The Rohi, a kind of fish. 	 2. A deer said to resemble an ass.
रौक्ष्य: रौक्ष्य n. (-क्ष्यं) 	 1. Roughness, ruggedness. 	 2. Harshness, unkindness.  E. रुक्ष hard, ष्यञ् aff.
रौचनिक: रौचनिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Dyed or coloured with Rochanā of a yellow-ish or orange tint. 	 n. (-कं) The tartar of the teeth.  E. रोचना a pig-ment, and अण् or ठक् aff.
रौच्य: रौच्य m. (-च्यः) 	 1. An ascetic with a staff of Bilwa-wood. 	 2. The thirteenth Manu.
रौट्: रौट्(ऋ)रौटृ, r. 1st cl. (रौटति) To treat with disrespect.
रौड्: रौड्(ऋ)रौडृ r. 1st cl. (रौडति) To treat with disrespect.
रौद्र: रौद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा or द्री-द्रं) 	 1. Formidable, fearful, terrific 2. Sharp, acute. 3. Relating or belonging to RŪDRA or ŚIVA. 	 4. Violent, wrathful, irascible. 	 mn. (-द्रः-द्रं) Wrath rage, (the sentiment as an object of poetical description.) 	 n. (-द्रं) 	 1. Heat, warmth. 	 2. Wrath. 	 3. YAMA. 	 f. (-द्री) GAURI, the wife of ŚIVA.  E. रुद्र ŚIVA, अण् aff.
रौद्रता: रौद्रता f. (-ता) Fierceness, formidableness.  E. रौद्र, तल् aff.; with त्व, रौद्रत्व ।
रौद्रदर्शन: रौद्रदर्शन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Formidable, terrific.  E. रौद्र, दर्शन appearance.
रौप्य: रौप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्यी-प्यं) Silver, of silver. 	 n. (-प्यं) Silver.  E. रूप्य the same, अण् pleonasm or aff. of relation.
रौम: रौम n. (-मं) A sort of salt; see the next.  E. रुम the place where it is found, अण् aff.
रौमक: रौमक n. (-कं) A kind of salt, according to some authorities, brought from a mountain in AJMERE, but in fact produced from a salt lake near the town of SĀMBHAR, about twenty miles west of JAYANA-GAR.  E. रुम the district of RUMA or SĀMBHAR, aff. अण्, and कन् added; also रौम and रौमलवण ।
रौमलवण: रौमलवण n. (-णं) Sāmbher-salt; see the last.  E. रौम as above, and लवण salt.
रौरव: रौरव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) 	 1. Formidable, horrible, terrific. 	 2. Dishonest, fraudulent. 	 3. Unsteady, slipping. 	 m. (-वः) 	 1. One of the divisions of Naraka or Tartarus. 	 2. A savage, a monster.  E. रुद् to weep, deriv. irr.; or रुरु said to mean a living being, अण् aff.
रौहिणेय: रौहिणेय m. (-यः) 	 1. A name of BALARĀMA. 	 2. The planet MERCURY. 	 n. (-यं) An emerald. 	 mf. (-यः-यी) 	 1. A calf. 	 2. The planet SATURN. E. रोहिणी the nymph, &c., ढक् aff.
रौहिष: रौहिष m. (-षः) 	 1. A sort of deer. 	 2. The Rohi-fish. 	 n. (-षं) A kind of grass.  E. रुह् to grow, Unādi aff., ठिषच्, the vowel changed to औ ।
